name: Spasenie galaktiki I. Pervaja vstrecha
source: Nikolai awaits a girl's visit with high hopes. However, she asks him to assist in an extraordinarily important and dangerous undertaking. Will Nikolai manage to carry out her request?
translation: 尼古拉满怀希望地等待着一位女孩的到来。然而，她请求他协助完成一项极其重要且危险的任务。尼古拉能满足她的要求吗？
